question: Unsa ang mga requirements, pila ang bayad kada hektarya, ug pila ka adlaw makuha ang Zoning Certification sa CPDO?
answer:
Sa Zoning Certification sa CPDO, ang mga requirements nga ma-require sa inyong kasagaran sa City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026 ay:

1. Certified True Copy ng Title(s) (1 photocopy) - ma-secure sa Registry [S1, S3, S5]

Ang bayad sa hektare sa Zoning Certification ay PHP 750/hectare [S2]. Ang mga adlaw nga ma-himo ang Zoning Certification sa CPDO ay:

4.4 Plots the technical description of the property, prints map and it will be returned - 1 Day [S1]
4.5 Re-evaluates the documents and prepares the Zoning Certification - 5 Hours [S1]
4.6 Signs the certification (initial and final) - 2 Days depending upon the availability of Zoning Administrator or Acting Zoning Administrator [S1]
4.7 Endorses the Zoning Certification to CPDO Administrative Division for releasing - 10 Minutes [S2]
5 Claims the Zoning Certification - 5 Minutes [S2]

Ang total na adlaw nga ma-himo sa Zoning Certification sa CPDO ay 3 Days, 6 Hours, 50 Minutes [S2].

ground_truth: The CPDO Zoning Enforcement Division issues Zoning Certification based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028). The checklist requires: Certified True Copy of Title(s), 1 photocopy, from the Registry of Deeds; duly accomplished application form, 1 original, from CPDO; Subdivision/Sketch Plan, 1 original, from Bureau of Land/private Geodetic Engineer; Order of Payment, 1 original, from CPDO; and Official Receipt, 1 original, from the City Treasurer's Office. The zoning fee is PHP 750 per hectare; the payment step depends on CTO processing time, described as uncontrollable time. The charter lists a TOTAL processing time of 3 Days, 6 Hours, and 50 Minutes.
